title: Cheekwood Historic Birdsong Lodge Nashville, TN
description: Experience historic charm at Birdsong Lodge, a 4,000 sq ft retreat near Nashville. Nestled on 9 acres along Sycamore Creek, this 5-bed, 4-bath lodge is perfect for groups. Enjoy two king Master Suites, an expansive Great Room, and a full kitchen. Outside, relax by the water features, gather around dual fire pits, or fish in the tranquil creek. Whether you're on the porch swing or exploring the lush grounds, Birdsong Lodge offers the perfect blend of nature and city convenience.
